title: Is symbolic ai dead? [D]
summary: New research keeps finding things that keep reintroducing symbolic ai structures to machine learning and I have wondered why more research hasnt been done with it. There was a heyday in the 70s for it but after neural nets came out it seems to be completely out of the discussions
reason: Reddit discussion thread asking whether symbolic AI is dead; it is commentary/question with no paper, benchmark, official announcement, or other artifact, so no group rule (research, industry, policy, tools) applies.
